Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_ID VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 :s_chapter_ID := :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_ID and
 chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID;
 if :coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_ID');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select distinct unit_ID
 into temp_unit
 from unit_attributes
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_ID
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID
 and attrib_group = 'PHER';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 begin
 select distinct unit_ID
 into temp_unit
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_ID
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID
 and contract_id = 'INTERNAL';
 -- internal unit, not pheresis
 show_error('0188');
 check_package_failure;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then -- import
 show_error('0400');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from components
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_ID and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_ID and
 product_code != 'NONE' and
 (nvl(system_label_decision,'39')= '39' or
 system_label_decision = 'Mq'); --HCL
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_ID');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0131');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select distinct product_desc, product_type
 into :s_product_code_desc, :s_product_type
 from components c, valid_products
 where c.unit_ID = :unit_ID and
 to_char(c.coll_date,'MM-DD-YY') =
 to_char(:coll_date,'MM-DD-YY') and
 c.product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 c.product_code != 'NONE' and
 c.chapter_ID = :s_chapter_ID and
 (c.system_label_decision is null or
 c.system_label_decision = decode(:GLOBAL.code_scheme,'I','Mq','C','39')) and 
 SUBSTR(c.product_code,1,5) = valid_products.product_code and --HCL
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) AND --HCL
 Unit_scheme_type = :Global.code_scheme; --HCL
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.component_prefix := SUBSTR(:product_code,7,2); --HCL
 END IF;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 
 end;
 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('valIDate_field');

 :system.message_level := 5;
 begin
 update components
 set bags_used = :bags_used,
 program_ID = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_ID = :unit_ID and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_ID = :s_chapter_ID and

 exception
 when OTHERS
 then

 end;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_success
 then

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
temp_bags_used number;
temp_count number;
temp_bag_code varchar2(10);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if :bags_used <= 0 then
 show_error('5219');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 /* if :bags_used not in (1,2)
 then
 show_error('1803');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;*/
 BEGIN
 select nvl(bags_used,1)
 into temp_bags_used
 from valid_products v, components c
 where c.unit_id = :unit_id
 and trunc(c.coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and c.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and c.product_code = :product_code
 and c.relabel_product_code is null 
 and c.reject_reason_code is null 
 and component_prefix = :component_prefix
 and v.product_code = substr(:product_code,1,5);
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 message ('Error checking bags used');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 IF temp_bags_used >= 1
 THEN
 reconcile_bags(:unit_id,:coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,temp_count,
 temp_bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 IF :Ctrl_blk_1.bags_used > temp_count + temp_bags_used
 THEN
 show_error('0262');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
